name: d1_causal_round1_v1
variable_under_test: the SECONDARY component's vague stated size word ('a small')

manipulation.BASELINE: Five Guys Little Cheeseburger and a small fries
manipulation.TEST: Five Guys Little Cheeseburger and fries
manipulation.held_fixed: burger identity/SKU, chain, meal structure, item count, and nearly all wording. ONLY the fries size specification changes.
manipulation.confound_avoided: An earlier draft used 'Five Guys Cheeseburger' as the test arm. ⛔ That is a DIFFERENT MENU ITEM - Little is one patty, Cheeseburger is two - so it would have varied product identity while being described as removing an adjective. If omission had moved, nothing could be attributed. Caught by Danny before qualification.

predictions_frozen_before_run.mechanism_supported: If a vague STATED size suppresses the structured ambiguity record, removing 'small' leaves the fries genuinely unresolved and should REDUCE zero-record asks below the c2 baseline of 5/8.
predictions_frozen_before_run.mechanism_loses_support: If omission stays around the 5/8 baseline, the stated-size mechanism loses support.
predictions_frozen_before_run.no_brand_conclusion: NO brand conclusion follows from either outcome. Brand is held fixed here and remains confounded in the prior data.
predictions_frozen_before_run.scope: This tests the SECONDARY-COMPONENT size word ONLY - not the broader claim that any vague size adjective causes D1. A first causal separation should be narrow.
predictions_frozen_before_run.threshold: Same rule-of-three cut as the base rate: >=3 of 8 asks zero-record = still omitting; <=2 = materially reduced; <4 asks = INSUFFICIENT. Run VOID if the control shows any zero-record ask.

cases.message: Five Guys Little Cheeseburger and a small fries
cases.label_note: [BASELINE] = c2 verbatim, in-run. Eligible (8/8 asks, tree 469f7e4). Base rate 5/8.

cases.label_note: [TEST] one variable: the fries size word removed. NEEDS QUALIFICATION.

cases.label_note: [CONTROL] = c16. Eligible (8/8 asks). 0/8 zero-record - anchors the threshold.
